Main Articles Locations New: Fairy Settlement (78~85)

New: Fairy Settlement (78~85)

Locations 05.01.2026

Kimerian, who was at odds with Fairy King Obelius, took his followers to Magmeld and lived peacefully in the beautiful land until present. However, the Fairy Settlement has been contaminated by the corruption of the Decaying Darkness, and the Fairies that have fallen sway to the Seed of Darkness are on the rampage.

Basics

Fairy Settlement — innovation from MasterWork team. Location consists of 3 zones with different difficulty, intended for exping and farming for solo players, mini-groups and full parties.

As the reward for hunting at Fairy Settlement you can get:

  • Resources, SP scrolls, attribute stones, S gems
  • Various codex for skill enchant
  • Enchant scrolls, including Blessed
  • Recipes, parts and whole S-grade items

To reach this location ask Liri Fairy Settlement Guide located on the left from Gatekeeper in Arcan city.

Everywhere at hunting zone large and small spheres, that restores HP and MP spawning.

Northern Valleys (mid)

Difficulty: Easy
For whom: Solo players, mini-groups
Herbs drop: Yes
Missions: 3 weekly
Elite monster: Floranis The Dew Keeper Lv. 81 , respawn gap 4-6 hours

Mechanics

Monsters in this part of location have 4 evolution stages that affects on their strength:

  • Simple (no title)
  • Imperfect
  • Mature
  • Wicked

Here you can find cocoons, that can summon stronger monsters. To do that you might need — Glimmer Crystal NG and Dark Glimmer Crystal Rare NG , that drops with a little chance from any monsters at the location.

There are few ways to interact with cocoons, all of them require "combat mode" (Ctrl button held):

  • Autoattack
  • Skill attack
  • Using Glimmer Crystal NG
  • Using Dark Glimmer Crystal Rare NG

Cocoon level 1

  • With 100% chance summons 3 simple monsters
  • With 33% chance summons 1 Wicked monster
  • After autottack summons 1 - 4 simple or Imperfect monsters
  • After skill attack 1 - 3 simple or Imperfect monsters
  • Using Glimmer Crystal NG with 100% chance summons 3 Mature monsters
  • Using Dark Glimmer Crystal Rare NG with 100% chance summons 2 - 4 Wicked monsters
  • After any interaction with cocoon with 33% chance next version of cocoon can appear

Cocoon level 2

  • After spawn summons 2-3 Mature monsters
  • Attacking cocoon summons 1-4 Wicked monsters
  • After using Glimmer Crystal NG cocoon disappears and next level spawning

Cocoon level 3

  • Autoattack spawns 1 simple monster
  • Attacking by any skill spawns 1 Imperfect monster
  • Using Glimmer Crystal NG summons 1 Wicked monster
  • Using Dark Glimmer Crystal Rare NG summons 2 - 8 Wicked monsters

Southern Valleys (high)

Difficulty level: Medium
For whom: Solo players, small party, full party
Herbs: Only from Violent monsters
Missions: 3 weekly
Elite monster: Glumwing The Wing of Sorrow Lv. 82 , respawns every 5-9 hours

Mechanics

Monsters at this zone has 4 evolution stages that affects their strength and loot:

  • Violent
  • Slightly Enraged
  • Fully Enraged
  • Brutal

Here you can find cocoons, that can summon stronger monsters. To do that you might need — Glimmer Crystal NG and Dark Glimmer Crystal Rare NG , that drops with a little chance from any monsters at the location.

There are few ways to interact with cocoons, all of them require "combat mode" (Ctrl button held):

  • Autoattack
  • Skill attack
  • Using Glimmer Crystal NG
  • Using Dark Glimmer Crystal Rare NG

Cocoon level 1

  • With 100% chance summons 3 simple monsters
  • With 33% chance summons 1 Brutal monster
  • After autottack summons 1 - 4 Violent or Slightly Enraged monsters
  • After skill attack 1 - 3 Violent or Slightly Enraged monsters
  • Using Glimmer Crystal NG with 100% chance summons 3 Fully Enraged monsters
  • Using Dark Glimmer Crystal Rare NG with 100% chance summons 2 - 4 Brutal monsters
  • After any interaction with cocoon with 33% chance next version of cocoon can appear

Cocoon level 2

  • After spawn summons 2-3 Violent monsters
  • Attacking cocoon summons 1-4 Brutal monsters
  • After using Glimmer Crystal NG , cocoon disappears and next level spawning

Cocoon level 3

  • After spawn with 33% chance summons 1 Brutal monster
  • Autoattack spawns 1 - 2 Violent monsters
  • Attacking by any skill spawns 2 Slightly Enraged monsters
  • Using Glimmer Crystal NG with 100% chance summons 1 - 3 Violent monsters
  • Using Dark Glimmer Crystal Rare NG with 100% chance summons 2 - 8 Brutal monsters

Eastern Valleys (top)

Difficulty level: Hard
For whom: Full group
Herbs: No
Missions: 3 weekly
Elite monster: Stemphil The Lord of Branches Lv. 82 , spawn time 4-6 hours
Darkling The Harbinger of Shadow Lv. 82 , spawn time 5-9 hours

Location populated by monster with very high amount of attack and defence. Besides that monsters using high variety of very inconvenient debuffs. If you are not strong enough it will be easier to farm here in solo target.

Mechanics

Not so long ago in Eastern Valley Cursed Centaurus were noticed.

Cursed centaurus have 30% more HP, and give more experience after death. Drop although better — Dynasty full items and new quest items Tainted Centaur Talisman NG .

During the Hot Spot all centaur monsters became cursed.

Talismans can be traded for recipes and parts of Moirai equipment from Liri Fairy Settlement Guide .

Upgrading Soul Crystal

At all zones of Fairy Settlement you can meet elite monsters, that can upgrade your soul crystal (SA) by killing them. Mechanics are equal to Tyrannosaurs — character should have a quest, and he has to last hit monster.

Dynasty quest

All players of seasonal server received Liri's Magmeld Letter NG — teleport scroll that is although invitation to the new location. Use scroll to teleport to the Liri Fairy Settlement Guide .

Liri Fairy Settlement Guide will tell you how to get access to Dynasty gear. You will have to find 3 fairy keepers, to obtain items needed by Liri. Talk to Liri to move into the Fairy Settlement and find keepers there.

Magmeld Fairy Lum Mid

Lum will ask to collect magical items in the Northern Valley. Collect everything you need and exchange it for The Wing of Inspiration NG :

Items

The Wing of Inspiration NG
The Wing of Inspiration NG

Required

Glimmer Crystal NG (100 pcs.) Dark Glimmer Crystal Rare NG (50 pcs.) Dusk Fairy Dust NG (4 000 pcs.)

Magmeld Fairy Ari High

Ari will ask to collect magical items in the Southern Valley. Collect everything you need and exchange it for The Flute of Harmony NG :
